tasks.short: Consult personnel to clarify program intent

steps.what: Send program intent and the open problems
Draft prompts to clarify program intent

loop.input: program id and the open question
loop.check: Each question names the program id on the request
loop.stop: One pass; stop if the open question is empty
loop.why_not_simpler: What the meeting will actually need is not a fixed list

steps.what: Consult personnel to identify problems
Suggest changes in a short written note
Confirm which suggested changes to pursue

tasks.design: The software developer posts program id, the open question and a proposed change on {PROJECT}. A bounded note drafts questions that clarify program intent from those fields only. The consult itself stays a {CALENDAR} meeting. The computer programmer writes the suggestions in {DOCS} and signs that note. The note is not a program change and nothing is applied.
tasks.previous_blocker: Intent lived in the meeting, so a later reader could not tell which problem was identified or which change was only a suggestion.
tasks.enabler_now: The ticket can hold program id and the open question before the meeting, so the note can cite them.
tasks.still_hard: Clarifying intent with managerial and technical personnel is a conversation. The programmer still has to hear what the words left out.
tasks.human_edge: The programmer identifies the real problem and decides which suggestions are worth writing down.

ambition.what: Write the agreed suggestion the same day, instead of leaving it in meeting notes

tasks.altitude: Preparation is shorter. The meeting stays the work, and the programmer can refuse to treat a suggestion as a signed program change.

reach.task: Turn a signed suggestion into a program ticket or close it
reach.learn: Which problems were identified and which suggestions were refused

evidence.claim: In a mid-size firm this task is a meeting. The useful record is a short note of problems and suggestions, not a transcript.
Digest [S4] says a coding assistant needs a person to review, and a drafted question list is not a change to the program.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer programmer. The task ends when the suggestion note is signed. Writing the program from that note is a different task.
Input contract: program id, open question, proposed change, attendees. Producer is the software developer. If the open question is empty, no question draft is run and the meeting still happens.
Use the ticket and calendar already in place before custom code. The high meeting share fits this task and is not moved into a system record.
The signed note has no authority to change a live system.
unknowns: Who must attend before a suggestion can be signed.
Whether some programs have no named developer.
How suggestions are linked to a later ticket.
research_questions: What share of consults end with a written suggestion the same day?
How often does the signed note contradict the first proposal?

already_counted.description: Programmer edits the question list before the meeting
The consult itself stays with the programmer

incremental.description: Keep the suggestion template aligned with new program types

approvals.approved_version: suggestion note signed in this consult

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes the question arrives in the meeting, so the draft does not run and only the note template is new. The high case assumes a short draft, but the consult and the suggestions stay with the programmer. No program change is counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct trial runs and judge the results

steps.what: Set the trial inputs and the desired information
Conduct scripted trial runs of the programs
Judge whether the instructions are correct
Note which applications failed the trial
Confirm the desired information was produced

tasks.design: The computer programmer records program id, input set and the desired information on {PROJECT}. A {DATA_PLATFORM} job conducts the scripted trial runs and stores the output. The programmer judges the cases the script cannot score, including whether the instructions are correct. A green trial is not acceptance. Nothing is deployed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Expected results lived in a notebook, so a rerun could not tell a real failure from a missing expectation.
tasks.enabler_now: Input set id and the desired information can sit on the ticket, and a job can run only when both are present.
tasks.still_hard: Trials with no expected value, and the decision that the information is the information wanted, stay with the programmer.
tasks.human_edge: The programmer decides the trial produced the desired information and that the instructions are correct.

ambition.what: Rerun a failed trial the same day the input set is fixed, instead of at the next test window

tasks.altitude: Scripted trials take less watching. The programmer keeps the right to reject a green run.

reach.task: Accept the trial record or send the program back
reach.learn: Which input sets passed by script and which the programmer still rejected

evidence.claim: Trial runs in a mid-size firm are a mix of a repeatable job and cases a person still has to read. The reading is the judgement.
Digest [S27] says models wrote vulnerable code in 45% of tests, so a green trial is not proof the program or its instructions are correct.
Digest [S4] says a coding assistant needs a person to review. This task does not let a trial result stand in for that review.
Digest [S9] and [S10] describe a small trial that was slower while people felt faster, so a smoother rerun is not booked as a large saving.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer programmer. The task ends at a signed trial decision. Fixing the program is a different task.

Input contract: program id, input set id, desired information, instruction version. Producer is the computer programmer, often from a note by the software developer. If desired information is empty, the script does not run.
Use the existing job runner before custom code. The meeting prior does not fit. Time today is on the trial screen and the result note.
A green script result is not the decision that the instructions are correct.
unknowns: Which programs have no saved input set.
Who may accept a trial when the programmer is absent.
Whether some trials can only run on a live system.
research_questions: What share of trials have a desired result a script can compare?
How often is a green trial still rejected?

already_counted.description: Programmer still sets expectations the script cannot see
Judging unscored trial output stays with the programmer

incremental.description: Add input sets when a new program path starts failing in trials

approvals.approved_version: trial decision for this input set id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes most trials have no desired information, so the script does not run and the programmer still conducts them by hand. The high case assumes scripted runs, but every acceptance stays manual. A green result is not counted as saved judgement, and no deploy is included.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Draw workflow charts and code the instructions

steps.what: Sketch the workflow charts and diagrams by hand
Draft charts that describe logical operation

loop.output: a chart that cites only those notes
loop.check: Each operation box names a note on the job
loop.stop: One pass; leave a gap where a note is missing
loop.why_not_simpler: A freehand diagram is not a fixed set of shapes for every job

steps.what: Draft a first series of coded instructions

loop.input: chart step ids and operation notes
loop.output: instructions that cite chart step ids
loop.check: Every instruction cites a step id on the chart
loop.stop: One pass; stop if the chart has no step ids
loop.why_not_simpler: Choosing the computer language phrasing is not a lookup

steps.what: Convert the charts into coded instructions
Review the instructions in the computer language
File the signed charts and instructions

tasks.design: Job notes land in {DOCS}. A bounded draft prepares workflow charts and diagrams that describe logical operation from those notes, and the computer programmer corrects them. A second bounded draft converts the signed chart fields into coded instructions. The programmer reviews that series, signs one version, and only then is the pair filed. No model merges or deploys.
tasks.previous_blocker: Charts were pictures and the instructions were a separate file, so a later change updated one and not the other.
tasks.enabler_now: Notes can be split into input, output and operation fields that a chart draft must cite, and the code draft can cite only the signed chart.
tasks.still_hard: The logical operation of an odd job, and whether the computer language version really follows it, stay with the programmer.
tasks.human_edge: The programmer accepts the chart and signs the instructions that match it.

ambition.what: Update the chart in the same change as the instructions, not in a later documentation pass

tasks.altitude: Less redrawing of routine charts. The programmer can refuse instructions that cite a step the chart does not have.

reach.task: Review the signed chart before a build
reach.learn: Which operations are on the signed chart and which were left as prose

evidence.claim: Preparing a workflow chart and then coding it is document work plus programming. The chart is the part a template can start. The coding still needs a person.
Digest [S4] says a coding assistant needs a person to review, so coded instructions from a chart stay a draft until the programmer signs them.
Digest [S27] says models wrote vulnerable code in 45% of tests, so matching a chart is not proof the instructions are safe.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer programmer. The task ends when the signed chart and the signed instructions are filed together. Running the program is a later task.
Input contract: job id, inputs, outputs, operation notes, computer language. Producer is the software developer. If operation notes are empty, the chart draft does not run.
Use the document template before custom drawing code. The meeting prior overstates this task. Time today is on the chart and the instructions.
Filing stores the signed pair. It does not deploy.
unknowns: Which jobs already have a current chart.
Who may sign when the programmer is absent.
Which languages have no instruction template.
research_questions: What share of jobs have inputs and outputs as fields rather than a picture?
How often does the signed code drop a chart step?

already_counted.description: Converting the chart into instructions stays manual

incremental.description: Update chart fields when a new operation type appears

approvals.approved_version: instructions version signed against this chart

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes notes stay as pictures, so both drafts rarely fire and the programmer still draws and codes by hand. The high case assumes fielded notes, but the programmer still corrects the chart and reviews every instruction series. Deploying is not counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write program documentation and code comments

steps.what: Read the program and the later revisions
Draft documentation of program development

loop.output: documentation that cites those revision ids
loop.check: Every paragraph cites a revision id on the list
loop.stop: One pass; leave a section blank when the summary is empty
loop.why_not_simpler: What a later reader needs is not a fixed sentence per revision

steps.what: Insert comments in the coded instructions
Check that others can understand the program
File the signed documentation with the program

tasks.design: For a program version on {DATA_PLATFORM}, a bounded draft writes documentation of program development from the change list in {PROJECT}. The computer programmer inserts comments in the coded instructions and rewrites anything a later reader would miss. The programmer signs one documentation version, and only that version is filed in {DOCS} beside the program. A draft comment is not proof the program is understood.
tasks.previous_blocker: Documentation was written long after the change, and comments did not name the revision they described.
tasks.enabler_now: The change list can name program id, revision id and what changed, so a draft can be checked against that list.
tasks.still_hard: Whether others can understand the program is a reading test a template cannot pass.
tasks.human_edge: The programmer decides the comments and the documentation match this revision.

ambition.what: Refresh comments in the same version as the code change, not weeks later

tasks.altitude: Less time writing the routine revision history. The programmer still signs the text others will rely on.

reach.task: Read the signed documentation before changing the program
reach.learn: Which revision the documentation describes and which sections are still blank

evidence.claim: Documentation and comments in a mid-size firm are written so the next person can read the program. The history can start from the change list. The comments still need a person.
Digest [S4] says a coding assistant needs a person to review, so comments inserted from a draft are not left unreviewed.
Digest [S11] reports a large field study with more completed tasks and a wide error margin, so faster documentation is not booked at that study's rate.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer programmer. The task ends when signed documentation for one program version is filed. It does not change the program's behaviour.
Input contract: program id, revision id, change summary, author. Producer is the change record. If the summary is empty, the draft does not run and the programmer writes from the code.
Use the document template and the existing change record before custom code. This task is document work. The low meeting share in the prior fits.
unknowns: Which revisions have no change summary.
Who the documentation is for, programmers or users.
Who may sign when the programmer is absent.
research_questions: What share of revisions have a usable change summary?
How often does a reader still ask the programmer after the signed text is filed?

already_counted.description: Programmer rewrites weak sections of the documentation draft
Inserting comments stays with the programmer

incremental.description: Adjust the documentation headings when a new revision type appears

approvals.approved_version: documentation version signed for this revision id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes change summaries are empty, so the programmer still writes documentation and comments from the code. The high case assumes a draft of the history, but comments and the sign-off stay manual. Reading time by others is not counted as the programmer's saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Meetings stay, but the programmer arrives with a short intent note, and charts, trial results and comments are filed as versions instead of loose files.
reach: Software developers can read the signed chart and the trial result without asking for a fresh copy.
System users get documentation that names the program version it describes.
skills_to_grow: Turn a workflow chart into fields before coding from it.
Separate a scripted trial from a result a person must still accept.
Write comments and documentation against one program version.
role.ambitious_version: Each program has a current chart, a trial record and documentation that name the same signed version.
